sr.title: PLOS ONE · Изотопы эмали и мобильность хунну
sr.passage: Methods and results: local bioavailable 87Sr/86Sr values derive from underlying geology modified by soils and weathering. Modern and Iron Age sheep provided the local baseline. Teeth forming at different ages preserve different childhood signals. Oxygen values overlapped across local/nonlocal groups; enamel carbon can reflect livestock products.

oxy.title: PLOS Neglected Tropical Diseases · Изотопное исследование средневекового погребения в Уинчестере
oxy.passage: Oxygen isotope analytical methods and isotope results. δ18O phosphate values were used to estimate drinking-water values with considerable uncertainty. The measured oxygen value was close to the archaeological British mean.

millet.title: PLOS ONE · Растительные продукты в древних рационах Китая
millet.passage: Results and Methods: Xinglonggou humans had bone collagen δ13C consistent with strong C4 influence. The study used a mixing model with animal and plant references, recognizing the unequal contribution of dietary protein and non-protein to collagen.

diet.title: PLOS ONE · Рацион жителей северо-западного Юньнаня в бронзовом веке
diet.passage: Isotope theory and results. Millet is a C4 plant, unlike rice. Consumer tissues are typically enriched in 15N relative to diet, but aridity, manuring, breastfeeding and other factors affect δ15N. Carbon isotope ratios can relate to marine/terrestrial food webs.

bayes.title: Historic England · Байесовское моделирование в археологии
bayes.passage: Defining the problem and building a chronological model: independent stratigraphic sequence is prior information, radiocarbon measurements are statistical evidence, posterior densities and credible intervals are reported as model outputs, and outliers can be evaluated.

bronze.title: Метрополитен-музей · Техника бронзового литья в Древней Греции
bronze.passage: Ancient Greek bronze statuary: copper–tin alloy has a lower melting point than pure copper; large statues were often cast hollow using lost wax, and separately cast pieces could be joined.

glass.title: Музей стекла Корнинга · Римское стекло
glass.passage: The Roman glass overview explains blowing glass on a blowpipe and the development of new forms; cameo glass often used opaque white over transparent dark blue.

vitreous.title: Музей стекла Корнинга · Определение стекла
vitreous.passage: Glass dictionary defines glass as an inorganic product of fusion that cooled into a rigid condition without crystallizing.

casts.title: Археологический парк Помпей · Слепки
casts.passage: The ash hardened around the bodies; as they decayed, hollows remained. Plaster was poured into these voids. Fiorelli perfected the technique; the cast-making program began in 1863.

vesuvius.title: ЮНЕСКО · Археологические памятники Помпей, Геркуланума и Торре-Аннунциаты
vesuvius.passage: Herculaneum was buried by pyroclastic currents. Areas still beneath the modern town were explored through 18th-century tunnels. Villa A at Oplontis is known for its frescoes.

stabiae.title: Археологический парк Помпей · Стабии
stabiae.passage: Stabiae includes Villa San Marco and Villa Arianna, large Roman villas with surviving wall decoration.

tut.title: Институт Гриффита · План погребальной камеры Тутанхамона
tut.passage: Plan drawn by Howard Carter records the numbered objects. Four nested wooden shrines surrounded a stone sarcophagus and three coffins, the innermost made from solid gold.

ram.title: Институт Гриффита · Фотографии раскопок Тутанхамона
ram.passage: A Harry Burton photograph documents remains of ancient workers’ huts near the tomb of Ramesses VI (KV9).

seti.title: Американский исследовательский центр в Египте · Гробница Сети I
seti.passage: ARCE surveyed and documented the tomb in 1996–1999. It is KV17, in the Valley of the Kings.

stone.title: English Heritage · Как строили Стоунхендж
stone.passage: Sarsen uprights and lintels connect with mortises and protruding tenons; horizontal lintels joined each other with tongue and groove. Sarsen and bluestone debris and broken hammerstones were found in a field to the north.

avebury.title: English Heritage · История Эйвбери
avebury.passage: The complex includes a bank and ditch and stone circles. Archaeological and geophysical survey suggests other structures stood within the enclosure.

woodhenge.title: English Heritage · История Вудхенджа
woodhenge.passage: Six concentric ovals of wooden posts stood inside an earthwork. Aerial photography revealed the site and excavation documented the post locations.

durr.title: English Heritage · Жилища эпохи неолита
durr.passage: Modern reconstructions draw on Neolithic house remains excavated at the Durrington Walls earthwork in 2006 and 2007.

needles.title: Смитсоновский институт · Иглы из кости и слоновой кости
needles.passage: Bone needles from Xiaogushan, dated about 30,000–23,000 years ago, illustrate clothing technology.

comb.title: Метрополитен-музей · Гребень из фиванского некрополя
comb.passage: Excavated New Kingdom wood comb bears parallel incisions and grip indentations.

whorl.title: Метрополитен-музей · Аттическое пряслице
whorl.passage: Artwork details date the Attic terracotta spindle whorl to the sixth–fifth century BCE.

harpoon.title: Смитсоновский институт · Костяной наконечник из Катанде
harpoon.passage: The barbed bone artifact from Katanda is dated to about 90,000–80,000 years ago.

horem.title: Фиванский картографический проект · План гробницы Хоремхеба
horem.passage: The measured plan and section are labeled KV57, Horemheb, Dynasty XVIII.

note: Original Britannica source failures and encyclopedia source substitution preserved in INITIAL. Revised options remove the direct leaks between landmark and Bayesian cards.
